limitations: Shared host with unrelated concurrent work; timing variability is diagnostic, not a production guarantee.
Prebuilt indexes; source import, publication and extension loading are outside query timings.
Antfly includes HTTP overhead and uses default server scheduling; DuckDB uses four threads.
Analyzers, normalization and scores differ between engines; cross-engine ranking is not an exact oracle.
Peak RSS covers the child process lifetime, including any publication performed, not query-only memory.
Current composition uses 1000 recent sample rows, not a full year of live HN.
Full archive and regional Antfly Cloud qualification remain outstanding.
sql_seed_finding: Projected metadata plus body, ordered by created_at ASC or DESC with LIMIT 1000, returned SQLSTATE 54000 on the sample. Local fixtures read the original Parquet outside timed requests; that SQL shape remains unqualified.
